NOTIFICATION UNDER SECTION 16 SUB SECTION (2 D) OF THE COAST CONSERVATION AND
COASTAL RESOURCE MANAGEMENT ACT, No. 57 OF 1981
Proposed 364 Units of Residential Apartment Complex - Stage 3
Randombe North, Balapitiya
ENVIRONMENTAL IMPACT ASSESSMENT REPORT

IT is hereby notified that the Report of Environmental Impacts Assessment study on proposed 364 Units of ResidentialApartment Complex - Stage 3 at Randombe North, Balapitiya, submitted by the Mr. Ajith Wijesinghe, No. 100, KinseyRoad, Colombo 07 as required by the Section 16(1) of the Coast Conservation and Coastal Resource Management Act,No. 57 of 1981 as amended by the Act, No. 64 of 1988 and No. 49 of 2011 will be available for inspection by the publicat the following institutions from 8.30 a. m. to 4.15 p. m. for a period of 30 days from 08.06.2018. (Except weekends andpublic holidays)
In addition, this report with 03 languages can be used in the official web site (www.coastal.gov.lk) of theDepartment of Coast Conservation & Coastal Resource Management.

(1)Ministry of Mahaweli Development & Enviornment, No. 500, T. B. Jayah Mawatha, Colombo 10(2)Coast Conservation & Coastal Resources Management Department, New Secretariat Building, 4th Floor,Maligawatte, Colombo 10.(3)Central Environmental Authority, No. 104, “Parisara Piyasa” Denzil Kobbekaduwa Mawatha, Battaramulla(4)Urban Development Authority, 6th & 7th Floors, “Sethsiripaya”, Battaramulla.(5)Road Development Authority, Denzil Kobbekaduwa Mawatha, Battaramulla.(6)District Secretariat, Galle(7)Divisional Secretariat, Balapitiya(8)Pradeshiya Sabawa, Balapitiya(9)District Fisheries Office, Department of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources, Galle(10)Regional Office, Coast Conservation and Coastal Resource Management Department, No. 274, Peellagoda,Unawatuna, Galle
